name: Total energy consumption
definition: Fuel, electricity, heat, steam and cooling consumed within the organisation, all sources

name: Share of renewable energy in total energy
definition: Renewable energy consumed divided by total energy consumed, in percent

name: Gross Scope 1 GHG emissions
definition: Direct emissions from owned or controlled sources (GHG Protocol Corporate Standard)

name: Gross location-based Scope 2 GHG emissions
definition: Indirect emissions from purchased energy, location-based method (GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance)

name: Gross market-based Scope 2 GHG emissions
definition: Indirect emissions from purchased energy, market-based method (GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance)

name: Gross Scope 3 GHG emissions
definition: Other indirect emissions in the value chain, categories reported

name: Total water withdrawal
definition: Water drawn from all sources

name: Total water consumption
definition: Water withdrawn and not discharged (withdrawal minus discharge)

name: Total waste generated
definition: All waste generated, hazardous and non-hazardous

name: Hazardous waste generated
definition: Waste classified as hazardous under the applicable law

name: Share of waste diverted from disposal
definition: Waste prepared for reuse, recycled or otherwise recovered divided by total waste, in percent

name: Total employees (headcount)
definition: Employees at the end of the reporting period, headcount

name: Share of women in top management
definition: Women in top management divided by all top management, in percent (target direction is a company choice)

name: Average training hours per employee
definition: Total training hours divided by employees

name: Recordable work-related injuries
definition: Recordable work-related injuries of own workforce

name: Hours worked
definition: Hours worked by own workforce (denominator for injury rates)

name: Gender pay gap
definition: Difference between average pay of men and women as a percentage of men's average pay (ESRS definition; GRI 405-2 reports a ratio instead)

name: Confirmed incidents of corruption or bribery
definition: Confirmed incidents in the reporting period

name: Share of at-risk functions trained on anti-corruption
definition: Employees in at-risk functions who received anti-corruption training divided by all at-risk employees, in percent

name: Share of payments aligned with standard payment terms
definition: Payments made within the standard (contractual or statutory) payment terms divided by all payments, in percent

name: Net revenue
definition: Net revenue (denominator for intensity KPIs)

name: GHG intensity (Scope 1 + 2 location-based) per net revenue
definition: Derived: (Scope 1 + location-based Scope 2) / net revenue

name: Energy intensity per net revenue
definition: Derived: total energy / net revenue

name: Total recordable injury rate (per 1 000 000 hours)
definition: Derived: recordable injuries x 1 000 000 / hours worked (GRI 403-9 allows 200 000 or 1 000 000 hours; ESRS S1 uses 1 000 000)
